title: fix(sandbox): accumulate successive writes in SandboxFileIO write mode

files.patch:
@@ -2537,6 +2537,7 @@ def __init__(
         self.mode = mode
         self.encoding = encoding
         self._closed = False
+        self._written: Optional[Union[str, bytes]] = None
 
     def read(self) -> Union[str, bytes]:
         """Read file content synchronously"""
@@ -2569,7 +2570,17 @@ def write(self, content: Union[str, bytes]) -> None:
             except SandboxFileNotFoundError:
                 pass
 
+        accumulate = "w" in self.mode and "a" not in self.mode
+        if accumulate:
+            # write_file replaces the whole file, so accumulate across writes.
+            if self._written is not None:
+                if isinstance(self._written, bytes) != isinstance(content, bytes):
+                    raise TypeError("Cannot mix bytes and str content in write mode")
+                content = self._written + content
+
         self.filesystem.write_file(self.path, content, encoding=self.encoding)
+        if accumulate:
+            self._written = content
 
     def close(self) -> None:
         """Close the file"""

+    def test_write_mode_accumulates_multiple_writes(self):
+        client = _FakeSyncClient()
+        with _fs(client) as fs:
+            with fs.open("/b", "w") as handle:
+                handle.write("first\n")
+                handle.write("second\n")
+        self.assertEqual(client.calls[-1], ("write_file", "/b", "first\nsecond\n"))
+
+    def test_write_mode_retry_after_failed_write_does_not_duplicate(self):
+        client = _FakeSyncClient()
+        with _fs(client) as fs:
+            with fs.open("/b", "w") as handle:
+                client.replies["write_file"] = RuntimeError("boom")
+                with self.assertRaises(Exception):
+                    handle.write("first")
+                del client.replies["write_file"]
+                handle.write("first")
+        self.assertEqual(client.calls[-1], ("write_file", "/b", "first"))
+
